title: Assistant Professor of Economics
description:
Position Title:

Assistant Professor of Economics

Compensation:

$90,000-$110,000

Department:

Economics

Start Date:

08/01/2027

About this opportunity:

The Department of Economics in the Miller College of Business at
Ball State University invites applications for a full-time,
tenure-track position as Assistant Professor of Economics beginning
Fall 2027.

Employer will consider sponsorship.

What you'll do and what you will bring:

Duties and Responsibilities:

Teaching a 3-3 instructional course load in Economics and a
broad range of undergraduate and graduate economics courses.
Maintaining an active research agenda leading to quality
peer-reviewed scholarship.
Engaging in Assurance of Learning (AoL) activities, curriculum
development, and holding a minimum of 6 office hours per week.
Participate in departmental, college, and university
service.

Minimum Qualifications:



PhD in economics or a closely related field from an accredited
college or university (ABD near completion at the time of
application will be considered, but the degree must be completed by
the date of appointment).



Preferred Qualifications:



Research: The successful candidate must show evidence of
the potential to produce excellent research at the Assistant level)
or have a strong track record of scholarship (at the advanced
Assistant level) in Applied Microeconomics.






Teaching: Exhibit exceptional teaching skills in
university-level economics courses. Ability to inspire students
interested in economics while helping them develop a solid
understanding of the concepts and their practical
applications.



Required Certifications:

N/A

How to apply:

For inquiries about this opportunity, please contact:

Dr. John Horowitz, jhorowitz@bsu.edu

Important: Please follow upload instructions for attaching
all required documents listed below . Only complete applications
will be considered.

REQUIRED APPLICATION DOCUMENTS:

Cover Letter
Curriculum Vitae - *Please do not use the Autofill feature for
your resume/vitae
Finalists may be asked to provide additional materials

References:

Within the application, you will be prompted to provide names and
contact information for three (3) professional references. NOTE:
Reference checks will not be conducted until the final round of the
candidate selection process.

Application Deadline:

This position will remain open until filled with a consideration
date of December 18, 2026, 12:01 a.m. Candidates submitting
application materials on or before this date will receive full
consideration. Review of applications will continue until the
position is filled.

What we offer:

At Ball State University, we understand the importance of balancing
professional responsibilities with personal well-being. That's why
we offer 12 paid sick days and 10 holidays a year. Plus, our paid
parental leave (6 weeks) is there for life's most significant
moments. We offer affordable health and dental insurance, robust
long-term disability and life insurance plans, as well a range of
retirement benefits to provide financial security to you and your
family. These benefits ensure that you can focus on your work and
personal growth without worrying about the unexpected.

When you work for us, you are family. And to show our support of
your family, we will cover 90 percent of your child's (or
children's) undergraduate college tuition at Ball State. This offer
is good from the very first day you start. It's just one way we do
our part to uplift you.

Let's fly together toward a secure and prosperous tomorrow.

Curious about our excellent benefits package?

We have developed a 
calculator that shows you the value of our core benefits.

Select the Total Compensation Calculator - Faculty and
download our calculator spreadsheet.

Relocation Program: MakeMyMove

Looking for a place where your career, community, and quality of
life can grow together? Muncie and Delaware County offer the
advantages of a university community with the accessibility and
affordability of a mid-sized city—short commutes, local arts and
culture, parks and trails, educational opportunities, healthcare,
athletics, and a strong sense of connection.

Through the City of Muncie’s 
MakeMyMove program, eligible new residents may access
relocation incentives, university-related benefits, co-working
options, and community-building opportunities designed to help them
get settled and connected.

Current benefits for eligible participants may include:

Up to $5,000 cash for relocation


Co-working space courtesy of The Innovation Connector
Access to the Ball State University Library
One-semester Rec Fit pass at Ball State University
Discounted Ball State Athletics tickets
Help desk for connecting to local resources
Opportunity for board participation
Six-month YMCA membership

Relocation programs on MakeMyMove have specific eligibility
requirements, and benefits may vary by program. Applicants should
review the current MakeMyMove page to confirm eligibility,
available benefits, and program status.

Ball State’s support for relocation resources and community
partnerships aligns with Destination 2040:
Our Flight Path , the University’s strategic plan. The plan
calls our University to work with community partners to promote
talent attraction and retention, foster economic growth in East
Central Indiana, and strengthen the economic and social vitality of
the communities we serve.

Explore the program and check your eligibility through 
MakeMyMove .
